body: Concrete witness for the supplied yaw helper: own reference +Z, left shoulder=(0.6,0,0.8), right=(-0.6,0,-0.8), so LEAD is forward. PunchShapeMath.line_yaw_deg gives -143.130 degrees, not positive. My principal +/-180 adaptation gives +36.870 here, but gives -6 after the shoulders cross the fore-aft line even while lead remains forward; it cannot satisfy the stated sign rule at every phase. Signed lead-forward blade angle atan2(dot(L-R,engagement),dot(L-R,cross(UP,engagement))) does satisfy it and reads +37.867 for the original guard. Please rule whether that anatomical angle is intended, or supply the required zero/unwrap for the literal line helper. No threshold relaxation. Separate concrete conflict: identical canonical guard applied to A and Y-rotated B preserves head pitch; A -12..-16 and B -2..2 are disjoint at frame0/last. Need a phase/role rule for this, not a widened band. Existing native roll and mesh exports retained; no production palette replacement.
